system.description:
The sorcerer’s hand becomes a venomous blade. The merest touch wreaks havoc upon his victim. The sorcerer’s hand becomes a weapon. He must simply touch his opponent to deliver his retribution. The damage done is according to the spell, not the successes of the hit. The touch has a damaging effect Power = Will +4. VA 1. Die of Fate to determine IMS. Weapon Length: as Hands; Range: as Melee.

Obstacle: 3^. Actions: 4.

Origin: Personal | Area of Effect: Single Target | Element: Anima | Impetus: Destroy | Duration: Sustained | Resource Points: 12

^ When pricing this spell in resource points, it costs 4 rps per point of obstacle rather than 2.

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 214
